continuation_request:
Your submission was cut off at the output token limit before the document was finished - only {characters} characters arrived, ending part-way through the markup. Do not start again and do not resubmit any part of what you already sent.

Call continue_html with two fields:
- last_line: the final line of the document you submitted, copied exactly as you emitted it. It is the text after the last newline, and it is almost certainly an unfinished line.
- continuation: everything that still has to come after that line, beginning at the very next character, finishing the element or statement it was cut off inside and running through to </html>. Keep the design, data and conventions you had already established.

The two fields are joined verbatim, so any character you drop or repeat corrupts the document.
